challenge_focus: Second delta pass over the changes made after the first delta pass. Open items from the previous delta pass, stated verbatim as findings to re-check, not as fixed: (1) P2 the generated gate command returns grep status 1 both when the shared region is clean and when a boundary is missing, so an automated caller cannot tell an unperformed scan from a clean one. (2) P2 impact-chain-gate.rb retirement-retarget refuses a whole package when it contains an unchanged executable helper (mode 100755). Report any P0/P1 or P2 in this delta.
